description:
## Problem
`_project/decisions/` contains 89 markdown decision records. The 2026-11-23/24 ADR audit covered only the ADR-titled records (and incidentally uncovered reversed trunk-concurrency decisions still cited as current by live `docs/internal/` runbooks). Roughly 80 non-ADR decision records in `_project/decisions/` have not been audited for reversals, missing supersession headers, or stale citations from live operational runbooks.

## Change
1. Conduct a read-only adversarial audit of the unaudited records in `_project/decisions/` against live workflows (`.github/workflows/`), scripts (`scripts/`), code (`benchbox/`), and live runbooks (`docs/internal/`).
2. Classify findings by severity (verifying live behavior directly, not from summaries) and identify any live runbook citing a reversed decision.
3. Present the audit report to the owner for adjudication; once approved, land the accepted status-note and live-runbook updates in focused PR(s).

## Decision gates
- STOP after the read-only audit and report findings to the owner before editing any tracked file (`[REVIEW-AUTH-001]`).
- Preserve point-in-time dated records: append dated status/supersession notes rather than rewriting historical Decision/Options prose.
- If a finding uncovers wrong shipped code or workflow behavior (not just stale prose), file a separate implementation item or confirm scope with the owner before mixing code fixes into a docs PR.

## Verification rubric
- Pass: audit report accounts for all 89 files in `_project/decisions/` (noting which were already covered by #4482–#4488 and which are newly verified), cites live file/workflow evidence for every finding, and every owner-accepted fix merges cleanly with passing `docs-reference-inventory-check`, `check_project_references.py`, `make pr-preflight`, and hosted `review-gate`.
- Fail: edits land without owner adjudication, historical decision prose is rewritten in place, or unverified `benchbox.dev` URLs are introduced.

## Guardrails
Audit phase is strictly read-only (`[REVIEW-AUTH-001]`). Remediation phase runs in a linked worktree (`make worktree-create`), never the primary clone. Verify every cited external `benchbox.dev` URL and section live before committing. Stage named paths only; commit with pinned human Git identity and no agent attribution or session labels (`[DURABLE-ARTIFACTS-001]`). Heavy work only via `make pr-preflight` / `make heavy-run`; never bypass `~/.benchbox/test.lock`. Open with `make pr-open`, arm with `make pr-arm`, and monitor to merge.
